title: Decision-making components and times revealed by the single-trial electroencephalogram
goal: Reproduce the source-defined five-event EEG finding, participant-level contrast-related inter-event latency effects, and original ERP/decision-accuracy relationships from the released cleaned epochs, preserving each result's source-defined analysis, eligible observations and indispensable controls. Keep the complete Table 1 contrast-law prediction and fit panel as a named empirical subresult. Evaluate improvement within its explicitly matched result family; lower Table 1 RMSE alone does not establish reproduction or improvement of the broader retained finding. Report new participant-held-out event-model or alternative-sampling analyses as separate extensions.
primary_outputs: Reproduction: executable analysis and source-native outputs for the corrected primary empirical findings: The retained empirical five-event EEG inference, source participant-level contrast/instruction effects on inter-event latencies, and original ERP/decision-accuracy relationships, beginning from released cleaned epochs. The complete Table 1 fixed-HMP-target law prediction and fit panel is a valid within-family empirical component. No every-figure, manual-acquisition/preprocessing or new held-participant event-selection requirement is inferred.
Primary improvement: unavailable until a source-grounded same-result comparison is independently justified; no new score or direction is implied.

Retained secondary work: Preserve the complete original Table 1 panel as a named empirical subresult with 54 contrast-left-out latency RMSE values, 54 full-fit latency R2 values and 18 Fechner accuracy R2 companions, retaining fixed source HMP targets and source-defined conditions/reductions. This is valid partial within-family evidence, not an unrelated proxy, simulation or merely preprocessing. Lower Table 1 RMSE alone cannot confer complete-family reproduction or improvement. New participant-held-out event models, changed sampling and other adapted evaluation remain separate prospective extensions.
success_criteria: Recreate the corrected primary empirical findings with their source-defined populations, complete required panels and controls.
Use an explicitly bound reproduction proposal only within its declared eligibility, comparison and execution limits; copying published findings is insufficient.

The preserved improvement.v1.json retains its declared comparison and coverage. Use retained_secondary_scope for its relationship to the corrected primary findings; satisfying a secondary or partial-component criterion alone does not establish complete primary reproduction or improvement.

The primary same-target outcome bundle is unavailable. Any primary improvement requires an independently justified source-grounded comparison; no replacement metric, direction or tolerance is invented.
Keep the paper+data and paper+data+author-code outcomes separate. All scientific outcomes remain unknown until qualifying original-data execution and independent verification.
Preserve prior task definitions, improvement criteria and useful secondary implementations with their original scopes. Historical attempts and source metadata do not become qualified AI results.

lineage_and_loader_evidence.assessment: 26 cleaned512Hz MNE epoch FIF files with source-written event_name/rt/condition/side/stimulus/response metadata; preprocessing and photodiode corrections are upstream fixed inputs.

input_routes.version: Each observed file version 1; example SHA256 edd10eab6ecbae73d26a19c17f9e8d0838d77e99c7756da7d53bc1f616531535.
input_routes.license: Public read access; node_license is null. An explicit data redistribution license was not observed.

lineage_and_loader_evidence.source_inspection_level: Saved metadata, author documentation and selected source inspection; this audit did not newly read payloads.

data_contract.neural: 26 files 0_epo.fif through 25_epo.fif, each about 271 MB; publisher and official loader identify cleaned MNE EEG epochs at 512 Hz.
data_contract.labels: Source preprocessing writes epoch metadata event_name, rt, condition, side, stimulus and response, from stimulus/condition/side/response triggers; notebook reads those fields directly for contrast, speed/accuracy and correct-response analyses.
data_contract.time_alignment: Photodiode correction is in the preprocessing source; epochs retain sample rate and events. The initial contract starts after those corrections.
data_contract.split: Freeze participant groups and complete trials for extensions; trial PCA/scaling and HMP model estimation must be training-only if claiming held-out prediction. Original full-data event discovery is a descriptive reproduction.
data_contract.controls: Behavior-only reaction time, response/motor preparation, contrast intensity, and alternative event widths/numbers; test that HMP interval interpretations survive participant-held-out estimation.
data_contract.biological_unit: Participant, not the number of fitted EEG samples or event-probability points.

versions_and_loader_contract.scope_description: Refit hidden multivariate pattern events on released participant EEG epochs, then compare sensory/decision interval laws and ERP evidence. Scope starts from cleaned epochs and does not recreate manual acquisition/preprocessing decisions.

input_assets.checksum_interpretation: Explicit sha256 fields retained; checksum/digest/ETag names are not silently reinterpreted. None means unrecorded, not verified.

official_code.lineage_limit: Author/source code meaning is preserved. A loader, demo, figure script and complete-paper implementation are not interchangeable.

provenance.interpretation: Pins bind saved local evidence. Asset hashes are source-reported unless an explicit acquisition receipt says otherwise.

resources.measurement_status: No project runtime/peak-memory measurement found; archive byte counts/HEAD lengths are input metadata, not execution measurements.

evaluation.reproduction_proposal: Only a proposal explicitly bound in outcomes.v1.json is adopted.

retained_secondary_improvement.improvement_loop: After source reconciliation, allow iteration on training/development law fits while final contrast errors remain inaccessible to candidate selection; source target generation is fixed.
retained_secondary_improvement.candidate_freeze: Freeze candidate law, parameter constraints, all fit-contrast memberships, population choice and complete-panel comparison rule before final evaluation.
retained_secondary_improvement.final_evaluation: Recompute original contrast-left-out RMSE for the full source panel against authentic source predictions and report event/ERP reproduction separately.
retained_secondary_improvement.baseline_policy: The published table is a numerical source result; exported score kernels are engineering components; rerun author results remain absent. Missing budgets and target parity block activation.

primary_source_limits: Exact cleaned-epoch and participant identities, EEG/RT masks, HMP output lineage and original inference/reference artifacts remain unqualified. Historical correct-only wording versus the source all-responded selection must be reconciled through source fidelity, not automatically restored.

Preserve source participant scaling, pooled covariance/PCA, event width, event/interval identities and source cumulative-fit event discovery using all participants and conditions. A new held-out event-selection score is not an authenticated original comparator.

Preserve both speed/accuracy conditions, source contrast/instruction coding and separate topography, mixed-model and ERP cluster procedures. Participant is the biological unit; trials and event estimates are nested observations.

Preserve the Table 1 fixed targets, complete target/condition/law cells, per-participant fits and contrast-left-out reductions. Changing HMP targets, participants, condition selection or sampling rate changes the comparison.

The authenticated Results report encoding Pieron R2 of 0.53 and 0.34, while literal Table 1 reports 0.57 and 0.30 for speed/accuracy. Preserve table-specific reference values within their named result and retain the paragraph/table discrepancy; do not silently mix or select favorable magnitudes.

Primary numerical agreement criteria and scientifically justified same-result superiority remain unresolved. Larger effects, smaller p-values or better prediction of fixed latent targets do not by themselves improve the complete empirical finding.

No explicit task-specific authority to replace the retained family with Table 1 alone was found in the bounded inspected records. A documented reviewed revision must be assessed on its actual terms; actively promoting Table 1 to sole primary is a new scientific scope choice.

Do not admit a complete-family reproduction/partial-component improvement bundle as complete-primary success if the schema cannot express its coverage relationship. Preserve the valid 126-value panel, scorer, source evidence and prior scoped reviews.
